sources.snippet: Model Description Supervised fine-tuned (SFT) version of the SakThai 0.5B tool-calling base model, trained on enriched multi-turn tool-use data from the combined-v10 dataset. This adapter refines the base model's instruction-following and tool-calling consistency through direct supervised learning on 2,965+ examples, improving multi-turn dialogue handling and JSON/XML format correctness.
